question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He was __uncomfortable__ at the sport event.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Easeful**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**uncomfortable**' means not comfortable or uneasy. (आरामदायक नहीं या असहज)

 
 
• **For example**: *The old chair was so worn out that it became uncomfortable to sit on.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of 'uncomfortable' is '**easeful**' which means feeling at ease. (आराम महसूस हो रहा है)
 
 
• **For example**: *Lying in the hammock under the shade of the trees felt incredibly easeful.*
 
 
 
• So, **Easeful **is the most appropriate antonym as it means providing ease or comfort.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Difficult **means not easy and is not an antonym of 'uncomfortable'. (आसान नहीं है)
 
• **Awkward **means lacking grace or uncomfortable and is a synonym of 'uncomfortable'. (अनुग्रह की कमी या असहजता)
 
• **Troublesome **means causing trouble or difficulty and is not an antonym of 'uncomfortable'. (परेशानी या कठिनाई उत्पन्न करना)
